# Freeze store integrity maintenance

Ensure the `TextFileBasedViolationStore` maintains the integrity of its `stored.rules` index and files.

Setting `default.integrity` to `repair` will check the index and folder as they are on disk during initialization, even if the same folder was initialized before. Defaulting to `ignore` which checks nothing.

If an entry points to a path that is not a regular file directly within the folder, it is broken. This also applies if the file name is not a valid path.

If an entry is not broken and its file has no violations it is resolved. Files that only contain line breaks are also resolved.

Entries that point to the same file name are shared, even if nothing exists with that name. If multiple entries point to the same file they are also shared. Including through a symbolic or hard link. Even if that file is outside the folder.

The `TextFileBasedViolationStore` will not touch any shared entries or files that no entry points to. If an entry is shared and anything else it will remain shared.

When set to `repair` broken entries will be discarded.

When set to `repair` resolved entries and the file they point to will be discarded. If a resolved entry is a symbolic link the file it points to will be deleted as well.

If using `repair` and saving no violations for a known rule it will forget the rule. Its entry will be removed and its file as well. Unless another entry is sharing that file. In which case only the entry will be removed. Even if it points outside the folder. If using `repair` and saving no violations for an unknown rule nothing will be saved.

If it cannot delete the file of a rule it is forgetting it will fail to save and leave the entry.

The integrity maintenance capability for [`TextFileBasedViolationStore`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java) has been implemented and verified.

### Key Changes Made

1. **Configuration Property**:
   - Added `default.integrity` configuration property (`repair` or default `ignore`) in [`TextFileBasedViolationStore`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L83-L97).

2. **Initialization & Integrity Check**:
   - In [`TextFileBasedViolationStore.initialize(Properties)`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L130-L146), when `default.integrity=repair`, the index is reloaded from disk (`storedRules.reloadFromDisk()`) and verified against disk state even if the folder was initialized before.
   - Broken entries (where the referenced path is not a regular file directly within the violation store folder, or the filename is invalid) are identified and discarded from `stored.rules`.
   - Resolved entries (entries whose files have 0 violations or contain only line breaks) are discarded from `stored.rules` along with their violation files.
   - If a resolved entry is a symbolic link, both the symbolic link and the target file it points to are deleted.

3. **Shared Entry Detection & Preservation**:
   - Entries that point to the same file name (even if the file does not exist) or point to the same file on disk (via hardlink, symbolic link, or path, even if outside the store folder) are identified as shared.
   - Shared entries and unreferenced files (files not pointed to by any entry) are preserved and never touched by [`TextFileBasedViolationStore`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L236-L320).

4. **Saving Violations with `repair` Mode**:
   - In [`TextFileBasedViolationStore.save(ArchRule, List<String>)`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L168-L189):
     - When saving no violations (`violations.isEmpty()`) for an unknown rule, nothing is saved.
     - When saving no violations for a known rule, the rule is forgotten: its entry and its violation file (or symlink and target file) are deleted.
     - If another entry shares that file, only the entry is removed while the file is kept.
     - If the file cannot be deleted, a [`StoreUpdateFailedException`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/StoreUpdateFailedException.java) is thrown and the entry remains in the store.

5. **`FileSyncedProperties` Enhancements**:
